_comment: Use-case config 1. Two-channel edge-delay: measure the delay from the CH1 falling edge to the CH2 falling edge. CH1 5 V/div (use 10 for 24 V calibrations), CH2 2 V/div. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: horizontal_scale in SECONDS (0.002 = 2 ms/div, 2.0 = 2 s/div), vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level in volts (or "half_battery" = half of battery_voltage). sample_rate is derived from record_length + horizontal_scale when null.
